name: ada2010
description: ADA 2010 Standards for Accessible Design / ICC A117.1 geometric pre-check pack. ADVISORY ONLY: a geometric pre-check, not a code review - verify with a licensed professional / AHJ. Thresholds encode common 2010 ADA Standards section values (36 in route, 32 in door, 1:12 ramp, 1:48 cross slope, 1/2 in threshold, 60 in turning space, Table 208.2 parking ratios) as DATA so a later edition or A117.1 swaps in. Several checks are name-matched or param-derived (handrail height, threshold, accessible parking count) and carry honesty notes; reach ranges and door maneuvering clearances are DELIBERATELY OMITTED because the model carries no fixture-height or door-swing geometry - faking them would be dishonest.

rules.message: ramp running slope exceeds 1:12 max (ADA 405.2) - advisory pre-check, not a code review
ramp cross slope exceeds 1:48 max (ADA 405.3); measured across the surface's inferred run axis - advisory pre-check, not a code review
ramp run rises more than 30 in without a 60 in landing (ADA 405.7); landing length is measured along the drawn centerline, width is not checked - advisory pre-check, not a code review
accessible route clear width under 36 in min (ADA 403.5.1; 32 in permitted at isolated points ≤24 in long) - advisory pre-check, not a code review
accessible route pinches below the 32 in absolute minimum at a point (ADA 403.5.1) - advisory pre-check, not a code review
door clear width under 32 in min (ADA 404.2.3) - advisory pre-check, not a code review

door threshold exceeds 1/2 in max (ADA 404.2.5); read from the door block 'threshold' param - a door with no such param is flagged 'not modelably detectable', verify by hand - advisory pre-check, not a code review
60 in turning space does not fit clear of obstructions (ADA 304.3.1); a simplified planar disc, no door-swing maneuvering geometry - advisory pre-check, not a code review
clear floor space narrower than 30 in (ADA 305.3 requires 30 x 48 in); only the 30 in width is checked here, the 48 in depth is not - advisory pre-check, not a code review

handrail top below 34 in (ADA 505.4 requires 34-38 in); handrails are name-matched curves and only the 34 in lower bound is probed (as clearance above the curve), verify height by hand - advisory pre-check, not a code review

too few accessible parking spaces for the total provided (ADA Table 208.2); total = objects named 'parking', accessible = those also named 'accessible' - a name/count heuristic, no stall geometry - advisory pre-check, not a code review
curb ramp running slope exceeds 1:12 max (ADA 406.1) - advisory pre-check, not a code review
